note: Palau: nationals of the Marshall Islands, Micronesia and the United States enter without a visa for a year, Taiwanese for 90 days, the Schengen states', the EU's but Ireland's and Israel's for 90 in 180, Russians and Seychellois for 30; everyone else gets a visa on arrival for 30 days (extendable twice, with proof of USD 200 a week), except nationals of Bangladesh and Myanmar, who need one beforehand. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Palau Visitors Authority, the state's tourism authority, which confirmed the 30-day visa on arrival, the year for Americans, Micronesians and Marshallese and the pre-approved visa for Bangladeshis and Myanmar nationals; the bilateral waivers (the EU, Israel, Taiwan, Russia, the Seychelles) stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Palau
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries may enter Palau without a visa for the following period in accordance with bilateral agreements: 1 year Marshall Islands Micronesia United States 90 days Taiwan 90 days within any 180 days European Union member states (except Ireland) Iceland Liechtenstein Norway Switzerland 90 days within any 6 months Israel 30 days Russia Seychelles ... Citizens of any countries (except Bangladesh and Myanmar) may obtain a visa on arrival. The visa is valid for a maximum stay of 30 days but can be extended twice for a fee.

sources.title: Palau Visitors Authority (the Republic of Palau's statutory tourism authority): Travelers Tips, 'Visa and Passport Requirements'
sources.said: All visitors must have a valid passport not less than 6 months from date of expiration and proof of return arrangements. VISAs are NOT required. 30-days Tourist Visa will be issued upon arrival and may be extended within 7 days in advance with approval of the Chief of Immigration for a fee of US$50.00 ... (Note: Maximum of 90 days ...). Citizens of United States of America, Federated States of Micronesia, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Guam, and the Common Wealth of Northern Marianas Islands with valid passports are issued 1 year Visa upon arrival. Citizens of Myanmar and Bangladesh must have a pre-approved visa.
